targets.rawSql: SELECT state, count(*) AS value FROM telemetry_events WHERE time > now() - interval '6 hours' GROUP BY state

panels.title: Approx. State Duration - last 24h (hours, gap/reboot-naive)
panels.description: Approximate only: unlike the /devices/{id}/analytics API endpoint, this panel does not exclude communication gaps or reboot boundaries.

targets.rawSql: WITH ordered AS (SELECT device_id, time, state, LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM telemetry_events WHERE time > now() - interval '1 day') SELECT state, SUM(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_time - time)))/3600.0 AS value FROM ordered WHERE next_time IS NOT NULL GROUP BY state

WITH ordered AS (SELECT device_id, time, state, LEAD(time) OVER (PARTITION BY device_id ORDER BY time) AS next_time FROM telemetry_events WHERE time > now() - interval '1 day'), durations AS (SELECT state, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (next_time - time)) AS seconds FROM ordered WHERE next_time IS NOT NULL) SELECT 100.0 * SUM(seconds) FILTER (WHERE state='ON') / NULLIF(SUM(seconds),0) AS usage_percent, 100.0 * SUM(seconds) FILTER (WHERE state IN ('SLEEP','OFF')) / NULLIF(SUM(seconds),0) AS power_saving_percent FROM durations
SELECT anomaly_type, count(*) AS value FROM anomalies WHERE detected_at > now() - interval '7 days' GROUP BY anomaly_type ORDER BY value DESC

panels.title: Estimated Avg Power by State, last 24h (watts, informational)
panels.description: Average of observed power_watts samples per state; used by the API as the basis for kWh energy estimates.

targets.rawSql: SELECT state, avg(power_watts) AS value FROM telemetry_events WHERE power_watts IS NOT NULL AND time > now() - interval '1 day' GROUP BY state
